settings.text: Anything else? Write to us and we answer within a day.

settings.question: Do I need Canva Pro?
settings.answer: No. Every project works on the free plan. Where a Pro feature saves time, the lesson shows it and a free way to do the same thing.

settings.question: I have never designed anything. Is that a problem?
settings.answer: No. The course starts with the brand kit and the basics of layout, and most students have never opened a design app before.

settings.question: How long until I make something?
settings.answer: The brand kit is the end of module one. With two hours a week, most people have it in the first week and a poster in the second.

settings.question: Can I follow along on a tablet?
settings.answer: Yes. The lessons are recorded on a laptop, and a short lesson shows where things are in the tablet and phone apps.

settings.question: Can I use the templates for clients?
settings.answer: Yes, for your own business and for client work. You cannot resell the templates themselves as templates.

settings.heading: Design your first post tonight
settings.text: The first lesson takes nine minutes. Fifty six lessons, five projects and a 30 day refund, for one payment.
